rationale: The Latin anchors (levavi animam/oculos meos, expandi manus meas, exaltabit caput) all point to a literal upward movement — raising hands, eyes, or the soul toward God — which matches raise.v.02 ("raise from a lower to a higher position"). While lift.v.03 ("move upwards") is close, raise.v.02 better captures the transitive, volitional sense of lifting/raising a body part or entity to a higher position, consistent with all four Latin parallels.
